lines.en: I fan my petals and drift through the cave.

lines.zh: 花茎下面的我，其实只有拳头大。
lines.en: Beneath the petals I am only fist-sized.

lines.zh: 我飘过苔藓，留下一线香。
lines.en: I drift over moss and leave a line of scent.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣一开一合，推着我走。
lines.en: My petals open and close, pushing me along.
I glide slowly along the cave wall.
Every few paces, I wobble.

lines.zh: 看，我的花在空中转了个圈。
lines.en: Watch, my flower spun a full circle.

lines.zh: 发光浆果在头顶，我飘过去。
lines.en: Glow berries hang above; I float toward them.

lines.zh: 我飘得慢，因为花瓣很重。
lines.en: I float slowly because my petals are heavy.
I circle the spore blossom cluster.

lines.zh: 洞里的风推我，我也推风。
lines.en: The cave wind pushes me; I push back.

lines.zh: 我的根须垂下来，轻轻打转。
lines.en: My little roots hang down and sway.
My roots feel light the moment they touch soil.
Another ring tightened — time to fly.
I settle on a dandelion to rest.

lines.zh: 花丛里翻个身，翅膀沾粉。
lines.en: I roll in the flowers and dust my wings.
I circle once along the flower stem.

lines.zh: 我用两根细脚抓着叶脉。
lines.en: I grip the leaf vein with two thin feet.

lines.zh: 我脚下的嫩芽，一根也别踩。
lines.en: Not one shoot under my feet may be stepped on.
I beat my petals and skim the grass tips.
Wherever the wind blows, I follow.
This loop is me looking for nectar.

lines.zh: 我停在花上，翅膀还在抖。
lines.en: I rest on a flower, wings still quivering.
I fly low so I won't hit the bees.

lines.zh: 我在一片苔藓上打了个盹。
lines.en: I dozed off on a patch of moss.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣在暗处微微发亮。
lines.en: My petals glow faintly in the dark.

lines.zh: 洞穴滴水的声音，我听了很久。
lines.en: I listened to the cave dripping for a long time.

lines.zh: 我把自己收成一颗花苞。
lines.en: I folded myself into a bud.

lines.zh: 地下没有风，我就自己摇。
lines.en: No wind down here, so I sway myself.

lines.zh: 我在等一滴水落到花瓣上。
lines.en: I wait for a drop to land on my petals.

lines.zh: 我的花蕊里住着一只小虫。
lines.en: A tiny bug lives inside my blossom.

lines.zh: 孢子花的气味让我犯困。
lines.en: The spore blossom scent makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，像一盏小灯。
lines.en: I hover in midair like a little lamp.

lines.zh: 我数着洞顶垂下的根须。
lines.en: I count the roots hanging from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 泥土的凉意从根须传上来。
lines.en: The cool soil rises through my roots.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开又合上一次。
lines.en: I open slowly and close once.

lines.zh: 洞深处有回音，我跟着哼。
lines.en: There is an echo deep in the cave; I hum along.

lines.zh: 这片苔藓是我的老地方。
lines.en: This moss patch is my old spot.

lines.zh: 我把花瓣合起来，像收起一把伞。
lines.en: I fold my petals in like closing an umbrella.

lines.zh: 洞壁上的水汽，让我的根须发凉。
lines.en: The damp on the cave wall cools my roots.

lines.zh: 我把一小团花粉拍散，看它飘。
lines.en: I pat a little pollen loose and watch it drift.

lines.zh: 谁把一株花种在这儿了，真好。
lines.en: Someone planted a flower here. How nice.

lines.zh: 我把花粉抖在主人肩上。
lines.en: I shake pollen onto my master's shoulder.
The pollen balls are ready.
I remember every light and every rain.
I cling to this flower and stay still.

lines.zh: 花粉在我翅上结成小团。
lines.en: Pollen is clumping on my wings.

lines.zh: 我记得一床很旧的被子。
lines.en: I remember a very old quilt.
I slowly fold my petals shut.
I count the little bugs in the flower's heart.

lines.zh: 这具花瓣身子，早就没有肺了。
lines.en: This petal body has no lungs left.

lines.zh: 我停在主人肩上，花粉还热。
lines.en: Perched on my owner's shoulder, pollen still warm.
I doze under a leaf.

lines.zh: 不动的树，最懂时间怎么走。
lines.en: Still trees know best how time moves.
My wings open and pollen drifts out.

lines.zh: 脚边的蘑菇是我的脚印。
lines.en: The mushrooms at my feet are my footprints.
I am waiting for a flower to open.

lines.zh: 花粉球替主人盯着那边。
lines.en: My pollen balls watch that side for my owner.
My thorns hide in the calyx.
My pollen is still hanging in the wind.

lines.zh: 我飘到你面前，停了一下。
lines.en: I floated in front of you and paused.

lines.zh: 你身上有花吗？我闻了闻。
lines.en: Do you carry flowers? I sniffed.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头转了一圈。
lines.en: I circled once around your head.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲太硬，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your armor is too hard; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我落在你的肩膀上试试。
lines.en: I tested a landing on your shoulder.
Your hand is warm like sunlight.

lines.zh: 我歪着花瓣，看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my petals at what you hold.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了苔藓，我有点难过。
lines.en: You crushed the moss; I am a little sad.

lines.zh: 我认出你的味道，是第二次来。
lines.en: I know your scent; this is your second visit.
Your breath blew me off course.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像看一棵大树。
lines.en: I look up at you like a great tree.

lines.zh: 我把花瓣张到最大给你看。
lines.en: I spread my petals widest for you.

lines.zh: 你不像洞穴里的任何东西。
lines.en: You resemble nothing else in this cave.

lines.zh: 我犹豫着，还是飘近了一点。
lines.en: I hesitated, then floated a little closer.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里，有花的气味漏出来。
lines.en: The scent of flowers leaks out of your pocket.

lines.zh: 我落在你的帽檐上，帽檐有点歪。
lines.en: I land on your hat brim, and the brim is crooked.
I can't tell flowers from foes.
That bug on your sleeve — leave it to me.

lines.zh: 你是风带来的，还是种下的？
lines.en: Did the wind bring you, or were you planted?

lines.zh: 主人一喊，我的花粉球就飞。
lines.en: My master calls, and my pollen balls fly.
You are much bigger than a flower.

lines.zh: 我的花粉球会自己找人。
lines.en: My pollen balls find their own target.

lines.zh: 你就是花飘飘说的那个。
lines.en: So you're the one Flutter mentioned.

lines.zh: 停在那里，让花粉看看你。
lines.en: Stay there and let my pollen look at you.
Let me see whether you are a bee.

lines.zh: 我飞高了，就朝敌人撒花粉。
lines.en: I fly up and dust the enemy with pollen.

lines.zh: 我的主人有危险，我上去。
lines.en: My keeper is in danger. I go up.
Your hat looks like a leaf.
I land on your shoulder to look at you.
You don't look like someone who tramples flowers.
I lift two of my petals.
You carry the scent of other flowers.
One of my petals fell.

lines.zh: 别碰我的花心，那里最软。
lines.en: Not my center; it is the softest part.
I curled up tight from the pain.

lines.zh: 这一点伤，够我飘歪半天。
lines.en: This little wound makes me drift crooked for hours.
My pollen spilled across the ground.

lines.zh: 你打碎了我的一片花瓣。
lines.en: You broke one of my petals.
I made a very small sound.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把断掉的根须甩掉。
lines.en: I shook off the broken root.
I need to hide inside my flower pot.
I cannot float; I will land first.
The pain curls my petals.
All my pollen scattered, and it hurts.
My stalk has been bent.
My wings won't stop trembling.

lines.zh: 花粉团没了，我护不住主人。
lines.en: No pollen left to guard my master.

lines.zh: 花瓣掉了一片，我记住了。
lines.en: A petal fell off — I will remember that.
I can still fly, so don't count me dead.
My petals have been knocked off.
I fell in the mud and can't get up.
A petal's been torn off me.
That is a flower! I float over at once.
That one in your hand is new to me.
One, two, three; two kinds still missing.
I circle the flower, reluctant to leave.
I remember every flower's color.
Raise the flower and I rise with it.

lines.zh: 这一朵有点蔫，但还是花。
lines.en: This one is wilting, but still a flower.

lines.zh: 我闻了又闻，鼻子都痒了。
lines.en: I sniff and sniff until my nose tickles.

lines.zh: 给我六种不同的，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me six different kinds and I will follow.

lines.zh: 别拿草敷衍我，那不是花。
lines.en: Do not fob me off with grass; that is not a flower.
Hold the flower a little higher.
One small drop is enough for me.
There is soil right beneath this flower.
I know the flower in your hand.
That nectar dripped onto a leaf.

lines.zh: 四种不同的花，才够我留下。
lines.en: Four different flowers. Only then do I stay.
Water. I hear water.
The sweetness makes my flight unsteady.

lines.zh: 这香味是从你兜里来的。
lines.en: That sweetness comes from your pocket.

lines.zh: 花蜜一滴就够，我不贪心。
lines.en: One drop of nectar; I am not greedy.
You knocked me into three spins.
I was bounced away and floated back.
Gently, my petals come off.
I bumped your back; it was soft.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了两根根须。
lines.en: That cost me two little roots.
I slid off your shoulder.
You walk too fast for me to keep up.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两朵花。
lines.en: We collided like two flowers.
I spun briefly and steadied again.
Do not headbutt me; I come apart.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜贴着你的袖子。
lines.en: My wing membrane is stuck to your sleeve.
Stones hit me. Now you.
When my owner is in danger, I take off.
You stepped on my flower stalk.
A pollen ball is already aimed at you.
That knock scattered my pollen.
Light as I am, I got knocked crooked.
You have crumpled one of my petals.
I have fallen off the flower.
Light as I am, the bump still shook me.
Our pollen mixed together.
His petals are paler than mine.
We floated side by side for a long while.
Flower to flower, no words needed.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把花粉撒给他。
lines.en: I shivered and dusted pollen onto him.

lines.zh: 洞里又多了一颗小花苞。
lines.en: One more bud in the cave now.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会长在苔藓上。
lines.en: Our child will grow on the moss.
He circles me like a bee.

lines.zh: 我们的根须缠在一起了。
lines.en: Our roots have tangled together.

lines.zh: 两种花凑近，气味变甜了。
lines.en: Two flowers close together smell sweeter.
The bees will carry word between us.
I give you my brightest petal.
My pollen has fallen into your flower.
I circle once above your head.
When the rain comes, we will bear fruit.
Before autumn, we must make seeds.
We bloom on the same branch.
Half my pollen is yours.
My flower's heart faces your way.

lines.zh: 花粉球落进土里，长出两棵。
lines.en: Two pollen balls fall, and two sprouts rise.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用花瓣兜。
lines.en: I have no hands, only petals to scoop with.

lines.zh: 这颗种子好小，我抱得住。
lines.en: This seed is small enough to hold.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片落叶，又放下了。
lines.en: I picked up a leaf and put it down.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物太重，我拖不动。
lines.en: Your dropped item is too heavy to drag.

lines.zh: 我把亮晶晶的东西推到角落。
lines.en: I pushed the shiny thing into a corner.
I flew off cradling one berry.
That flower on the ground, I am keeping it.
Petals cannot grip this iron.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏进苔藓底下。
lines.en: I hid the thing beneath the moss.

lines.zh: 捡东西要慢慢来，不然会掉。
lines.en: Picking things up slowly, or they drop.
This grain of pollen — I tuck it into my core.
The nectar that fell is mine.
This seed is as light as ash.
One small piece. A whole day's joy.

lines.zh: 花粉球装好了，主人别慌。
lines.en: Pollen balls loaded. Don't worry, master.
You smell of flowers — I'll follow.
I push it back under the flower with my feet.
This flower — I've tucked it into my branches.
This will line my little nest.
I tuck it into my calyx.
Something trampled my flowers.
I have my eye on that crawler.
It is too close to my flower patch.
I fly higher to see it clearly.
I have decided to chase it off.
My petals have gone taut.
Pollen gathers into a ball inside me.
That is the one, that dark shape.
I place myself before the flower patch.

lines.zh: 我不会咬人，但我会扔东西。
lines.en: I do not bite, but I do throw.
You touched my flower; I remember.

lines.zh: 我扇着大花浮起来，追你的花弹。
lines.en: I lift on my petals, and the petal shot follows.
My master is in danger. Taking off.

lines.zh: 我的花粉球认得你的味道。
lines.en: My pollen balls know your scent.
You felled a tree. I remember.
I am airborne now, so don't think you will pick me.
The pollen orb has you locked — don't run.
My pollen is on you now.
My pollen ball is aimed at you.
My pollen ball has locked on to you.

lines.zh: 我悬在它头顶，慢慢瞄准。
lines.en: I hover above it, taking slow aim.

lines.zh: 它跑到哪，我的花粉跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever it runs, my pollen follows.
I looped halfway around the cave.
My petals beat very fast.

lines.zh: 它抬头找我，我已经在另一边。
lines.en: It looks up for me; I am already elsewhere.

lines.zh: 花粉球在空中拐了个弯。
lines.en: The pollen ball curved in midair.

lines.zh: 我飘得很稳，像一片叶子。
lines.en: I drift steady as a leaf.
It hides behind a rock.
I swing around from above.
This shot will not miss.
I hover over your head and won't leave.

lines.zh: 我的粉已经落在你肩上。
lines.en: My dust has already settled on your shoulder.
The pollen ball has locked on.
I circle before your eyes until you are dizzy.
I beat slowly, but you won't get far.
My pollen balls will chase you down.
Each step you back away, I follow one.

lines.zh: 别撞我的翅膀，我正送粉。
lines.en: Not the wings. I'm carrying pollen.

lines.zh: 我飞上去，花粉球会替我追。
lines.en: I fly up; my pollen balls chase for me.
My pollen ball has you locked.

lines.zh: 我朝下扔出一颗花粉球。
lines.en: I fling a pollen ball downward.
The pollen bursts and coats its face.
I am no fighter, only a dodger.
This ball will bend to follow it.

lines.zh: 我飘得太近，差点被抓住。
lines.en: I drifted too close and nearly got grabbed.

lines.zh: 我的花盆替我挡了一下。
lines.en: My flower pot took the hit for me.
Powder fell into its eyes.
I retreat to the ceiling and throw again.
It is not heavy, only very annoying.
I drift away right after throwing.
That was every bit of strength I have.
The pollen ball is already in the air.
I throw pollen into your eyes.
My thorn slides out from the petals.
I swipe your face with my wingtip.
The stamen hides a thorn.
Don't underestimate a flower's strength.
Higher up, I scatter the pollen down.

lines.zh: 花粉球先出去，我随后到。
lines.en: The pollen ball goes first; I follow.
My wings raise a puff of pollen.
I push up through a crack in the moss.
A flower opened in the cave.
My petals still carry dew.

lines.zh: 上面的钟乳石滴了一滴水给我。
lines.en: A stalactite dripped one drop for me.
This lush cave is quiet.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是发光的浆果。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was glowing berries.

lines.zh: 我试着扇动花瓣，飘起来了。
lines.en: I tried fanning my petals and rose.

lines.zh: 泥土认得我，我认得泥土。
lines.en: The soil knows me; I know the soil.

lines.zh: 一颗孢子花在我旁边开了。
lines.en: A spore blossom opened beside me.
The cave gained one little lamp.
I slowly pushed my way out of a bud.

lines.zh: 我落在苔藓上，先歇一会儿。
lines.en: I landed on moss to rest a moment.

lines.zh: 这一圈年轮，从今天长起。
lines.en: This ring of mine starts growing today.

lines.zh: 花瓣抖开，我从花心里醒。
lines.en: Petals unfold; I wake inside the flower.

lines.zh: 主人一招手，我就飞上去。
lines.en: One gesture from my master and I fly up.
I have pushed out of the bud.
My roots haven't caught the soil yet.
I poke my head out of the bud.
I shake the dew off my wings.
Inside the flower, I opened my eyes.
Among these flowers, I am the new one.
The flower just opened, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我从一粒花粉里长出来。
lines.en: I grew out of a single grain of pollen.
I hang from a slender stem.
Fire curled the edges of my petals.

lines.zh: 火苗一过，我的花瓣卷了。
lines.en: The flame passed, and my petals curled.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶摔下来，根须断了。
lines.en: I fell from the cave ceiling; roots snapped.
I dropped straight off the stalk.
Water soaked me heavy and I sank.
I'm floating. This is wrong.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我掀到墙上。
lines.en: The blast threw me against the wall.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的花瓣掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flipped my petals inside out.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的花瓣。
lines.en: An arrow passed through my petals.

lines.zh: 花球还没吐出，箭先到了。
lines.en: The pollen ball was not out yet when the arrow came.

lines.zh: 药水雾气让我花瓣发麻。
lines.en: Potion mist numbed my petals.

lines.zh: 这光不对，冷得我花粉都收了。
lines.en: This light is wrong, so cold my pollen drew in.

lines.zh: 我好久没喝到一滴露水。
lines.en: I have not tasted dew in a long while.
Starving. Roots find nothing.

lines.zh: 雷声从洞口传进来，我缩紧了。
lines.en: Thunder rolled in from the entrance; I shrank.

lines.zh: 雷把我翅膀上的粉打散了。
lines.en: Lightning scattered the dust from my wings.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有苔藓，我抓不住。
lines.en: There is no moss in the void to hold.

lines.zh: 根抓不住虚空，我的花瓣在飘。
lines.en: My roots find no purchase in the void; my petals drift.
